name: WyberAi
description: WyberAi is an AI app builder. This connector lets Claude create WyberAi projects, queue builds and edits, track build status, and publish finished apps to live public URLs — all against the user's own WyberAi account. Reads are free; builds consume the account's WyberAi credits at the same rates as the web editor. Free accounts include 50 credits.

_published_faq.name: How do I add WyberAi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WyberAi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://wyberai.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WyberAi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WyberAi lists 20 MCP tools, including create_project, delete_project, duplicate_project, execute_sql, get_account, get_database_status, get_message_status, get_project, get_project_knowledge, list_connectors, list_files, and list_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to WyberAi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to WyberAi in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
WyberAi requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
WyberAi is developed by SignalPulse Technologies. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
